items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: I got Toshiko Akiyoshi recordings that way that were not out here.

ctx.x: Did you find yourself eventually helping to produce new recordings? Was that part of your goal with Evidence Records?

It was never my goal. I’ll tell you why that happened. Good question, Monk. I had made great deals in France and Germany and eventually Japan. I had great deals with King Records and other Japanese labels. I got Toshiko Akiyoshi recordings that way that were not out here. So I was happy doing all that. And then I put out one guy who was particularly and just so the listeners know, I wasn’t really licensing French and German and Japanese artists, these were all recordings by American artists that had been made by…

guitarist named Melvin Taylor, and I am going to answer your question. I’m going to answer it through a discussion of Melvin Taylor. Melvin Taylor was from Chicago and he used to play in a club that’s still active and very hip and that’s called Rosa’s Lounge. He did not go on tours of the United States. He didn’t really play at other clubs in Chicago. He didn’t come into New York. He didn’t do that. He had a once a week gig at Rosa’s Lounge, this guitarist Melvin Taylor. And he was extremely popular there because…
